ns2:course.label: Pan Africanism
ns2:course.description: Provides an introduction to Pan African political movements and ideologies from the Americas to continental Africa. Examines the political, social, economic, and ideological relationships and connections between Africans and their descendants in the diaspora from an historical and comparative perspective. Same as AFRO 243, AFST 243, and SOC 267.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Non-Western Cultures, and Social Sciences course.
